summary: Shift4 Payments, Inc. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its existing credit agreement, adding $1.0 billion of incremental senior secured term loans and extending the revolving credit facility maturity to July 8, 2031. The proceeds are for fees and general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing event, not a special situation. There is no change of control, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic transaction.
